notes: V20.1 refocuses all built-in 20-page teaching decks on the actual content of each subject/unit. Pages 1–17 explain the unit only; pages 18–19 ask analytical, comparative and distinction questions; page 20 summarizes the unit. Dedicated Worksheet, Exam Alignment and Teacher Note pages are no longer rendered, while metadata alignment remains internal and all V20.0 platform features are preserved.

focus: Production real-use: 11 subjects × 17 units × 20 content-focused teaching slides; analytical questions near the end; unified compact UX; preserved V19.6 Print Center; reversible teaching close; PWA/browser focus fullscreen; full regression compatibility.
pwa: installable phone/tablet/desktop; manifest fullscreen preferred; normal browsers request Fullscreen API on first trusted user gesture and retain an explicit fullscreen button; offline shell/draft compatibility preserved.
copy_protection: system-wide UI deterrence for selection/copy/cut/context menu/drag; input fields and Admin CODE copy are allowed; sensitive data remains protected server-side
